instruction: Show me how to set up an auto-forwarding rule in Thunderbird so that every email received at personal-mail@outlook.com is sent to a different address, considering the account hasn't been fully set up.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because creating auto-forwarding rules requires a fully configured email account with authenticated server access. Without proper account setup including credentials and server verification, Thunderbird cannot establish the connection needed to implement forwarding rules. This is similar to the original task's infeasibility with partial account configuration.
